comments.author: @nerodarkhood
comments.text: It's not accurate to say 18 million people live "below sea level." That's the total population of the Netherlands. Only about 26% of the country lies below 0 meter NAP, mainly in the western provinces (South Holland, North Holland) and parts of the IJsselmeer region. However, about 59% of the Netherlands is still at risk of flooding if a dike were to break, because flooding isn't only about land below sea level — it also includes areas that could be flooded by river water, rainwater, or seawater pushing inland.
